title: Roundabout Entry: Yield Before Joining
short: You want to enter the roundabout.
intro: You are approaching the entrance. The blue car is already inside the roundabout.
watchCaption: The circulating blue car is nearing your entrance.
safeCaption: You enter behind the blue car, heading right.
unsafeCaption: Your entry would block circulating traffic.
safeFeedback: Traffic already in the circle goes first. You enter behind blue with room between the cars.

feedback.enter-now: Blue already had the lane. Entering ahead cut across its path. Wait for a gap behind it.
